note: Split It Up: three groups of twelve split into tens and ones, then twelve times three splits into ten times three plus two times three. Quiz: hear a split and pick the result / drag the three results of a split / find the sentence that is split wrong.

lines.text: Look! We have three groups of twelve.
Let's count the tens and ones separately.
Twelve times three is the same as ten times three, plus two times three.
Fourteen times two. Ten times two, plus four times two.
Twelve times four. Ten times four, plus two times four.
Thirteen times three. Ten times three, plus three times three.
Fifteen times four. Ten times four, plus five times four.
Fifteen times three. Ten times three, then five times three.
Twelve times four. Ten times four, then two times four.
Thirteen times five. Ten times five, then three times five.
